setup.s1.hint: A display name shown in the header. The accent color tints buttons and links.
setup.s2.hint: Used for the empty-start seed and as the dashboard fallback. Three-letter ISO code.
setup.s3.hint: FinanceOS does not enforce auth itself — the chosen mode is honoured by reverse-proxies and the optional Basic-Auth middleware.

setup.s7.hint: Last check. Below is what will be written. Click Confirm to finalize.
settings.branding.heading: Branding

settings.reports.heading: Report → Category mapping
settings.reports.intro: Some reports filter transactions by category. Map each report to whatever your categories are called — defaults match the canonical category set shipped with FinanceOS.

reports.runway.explainer.summary: How these runway figures are calculated
reports.runway.explainer.net_worth: Net worth = sum of your active own accounts (non-custody, non-pass-through), converted to {currency}.
reports.runway.explainer.no_income: Runway (no income) = net worth ÷ avg. monthly expenses over last 12 months. All operational expenses counted (custody and non-PnL excluded).
reports.runway.explainer.essentials: Runway (essentials only, no income) = net worth ÷ avg. monthly essential expenses. Uses the essential flag from Settings → Categories. Currently {n} {cat_word} flagged non-essential and excluded here: {list}{more}.
reports.runway.explainer.with_income: Runway (with income) = net worth ÷ avg. monthly net burn (expenses − income). Infinite if net positive.
reports.runway.explainer.recent: Runway (last 3 mo pace) = net worth ÷ avg. last-3-months expenses. More sensitive to recent trend.
reports.runway.explainer.footer: Edit which categories count as essential in Settings → Categories → Essential column.
